subject: Trump
scope: Single front-facing source photograph; subjective cosmetic appearance assessment, not a person-invariant measurement.

report.summary: Fairly symmetrical masculine face with prominent jaw, arched brows, and distinctive swept-back blond hair. Features show moderate angularity with some proportional irregularities. Skin appears smooth with visible creasing at eye corners. Overall presentation is memorable rather than conventionally harmonious.

potential.label: Refined Executive Presentation
potential.summary: Subtle grooming adjustments could enhance polish: managing hairline visibility through styling direction, softening eye-area creasing with targeted skincare, and maintaining consistent brow density.
focusAreas: Hairline styling direction for crown coverage

categories.title: Eyes
categories.subtitle: Periocular balance and eye-line structure
categories.explanation: Small, deep-set blue eyes with noticeable crow's-feet creasing at outer corners. The eyes appear slightly asymmetrical in openness, with the left eye marginally more closed than the right in this expression.
categories.recommendation: Retake under consistent lighting and a neutral expression before judging the eye area across reports.

categories.title: Nose
categories.subtitle: Bridge alignment and central facial axis
categories.explanation: Straight bridge with a rounded, moderately projecting tip. The nose appears proportionally average in width, with subtle asymmetry in nostril visibility from this frontal angle.
categories.recommendation: Compare several neutral front images before deciding whether nose balance is the main limiter.

categories.title: Mouth
categories.subtitle: Lip shape, width, and lower-third fit
categories.explanation: Wide smile revealing upper teeth with even alignment. The upper lip is relatively thin, while the lower lip shows more fullness; smile lines extend prominently from nose to mouth corners.
categories.recommendation: Use neutral expression consistency and simple grooming before judging mouth balance.

categories.title: Jaw
categories.subtitle: Mandible definition and chin support
categories.explanation: Strong, squared jaw with pronounced masseter definition and a rounded chin. The jawline creates a broad lower facial third with clear angularity and masculine projection.
categories.recommendation: Keep neck posture consistent; the jaw already has enough visible structure.

categories.title: Dimorphism
categories.subtitle: Sex-typical cues weighted against harmony
categories.explanation: Dimorphism is scored from sex-typical facial cues while penalizing traits that overpower harmony or proportional balance.
categories.recommendation: Use grooming and styling first; align brows, hair, and lower-third presentation before judging contrast.

categories.title: Face shape
categories.subtitle: Frame, thirds, and silhouette continuity
categories.explanation: Oval-to-round overall shape with a broad forehead and strong chin. Facial thirds show the lower third dominating slightly, with the middle and upper thirds appearing more compact.
categories.recommendation: Improve haircut, framing, and camera posture first because those change the visible outline fastest.

categories.title: Facial definition
categories.subtitle: Cheek and lower-face clarity
categories.explanation: Full, rounded cheeks with a flushed tone that softens the lower midface. The cheek prominence sits relatively high, blending into visible nasolabial folds.
categories.recommendation: Retake future scans with the same lighting, posture, and camera distance before judging soft-tissue fullness.

categories.title: Skin Age
categories.subtitle: Visible age cues
categories.explanation: Generally smooth surface with warm, even tone and visible fine lines at expression zones. Some texture variation across the forehead and around the eyes with no prominent marks.
categories.recommendation: Keep capture conditions consistent so future reports compare visible age cues fairly.

categories.title: Symmetry
categories.subtitle: Left-right balance across visible landmarks
categories.explanation: Reasonable bilateral symmetry with subtle left-right variations in eye openness, brow height, and smile elevation. The hairline shows slight irregularity at the temples.
categories.recommendation: Retake future scans straight-on before judging whether the asymmetry is persistent.

categories.title: UV context
categories.subtitle: UV context and visible tone
categories.explanation: Generally smooth surface with warm, even tone and visible fine lines at expression zones. Some texture variation across the forehead and around the eyes with no prominent marks.
categories.recommendation: Use consistent outdoor context and neutral lighting so future scans compare visible tone and texture fairly.

categories.title: Overall
categories.subtitle: Final calibrated assessment
categories.explanation: The overall score is the public report score on a 0 to 10 scale. PSL calibration remains a secondary rubric signal for comparison contexts.
categories.recommendation: Improve the lowest-scoring category first; one focused change beats scattered glow-up advice.

categories.explanation: Small, deep-set blue eyes with noticeable crow's-feet creasing at outer corners. The eyes appear slightly asymmetrical in openness, with the left eye marginally more closed than the right in this expression.
Light, arched brows with moderate density and visible individual hairs. The arches peak toward the outer thirds, creating an alert, expressive frame that lightens toward the temples.
Straight bridge with a rounded, moderately projecting tip. The nose appears proportionally average in width, with subtle asymmetry in nostril visibility from this frontal angle.
Wide smile revealing upper teeth with even alignment. The upper lip is relatively thin, while the lower lip shows more fullness; smile lines extend prominently from nose to mouth corners.
Strong, squared jaw with pronounced masseter definition and a rounded chin. The jawline creates a broad lower facial third with clear angularity and masculine projection.
Full, rounded cheeks with a flushed tone that softens the lower midface. The cheek prominence sits relatively high, blending into visible nasolabial folds.
Oval-to-round overall shape with a broad forehead and strong chin. Facial thirds show the lower third dominating slightly, with the middle and upper thirds appearing more compact.
Interocular distance appears slightly narrow relative to facial width. The mouth width aligns closely with pupil distance, while nose length occupies a moderate central vertical proportion.
Reasonable bilateral symmetry with subtle left-right variations in eye openness, brow height, and smile elevation. The hairline shows slight irregularity at the temples.
Generally smooth surface with warm, even tone and visible fine lines at expression zones. Some texture variation across the forehead and around the eyes with no prominent marks.
Distinctive voluminous blond styling with significant height and backward sweep. The hairline is receded at temples with visible scalp; color lightens considerably at the crown and front.
Medium-sized ears set at moderate projection with visible helix and antihelix structure. The left ear appears slightly more prominent in this frontal view.
